jira_task.summary: Insulin Control Protocol for Non-Critical Hospitalized Patients - EMAR Changes
jira_task.description:
{*}User Requirement{*}: 
This requirement introduces a Non-Critical Insulin Protocol that calculates and recommends a correction insulin dose based on the patient's BMI, latest HGT value, and whether the administration is a bedtime dose. The recommendation is presented in eMAR for nurse consideration during administration.
*Pre-Requisite:*
The protocol shall be applicable only when:
 * Insulin Flag is enabled in the Drug Master.
 * Insulin Protocol Type is selected as Non-Critical Insulin Protocol.
 * An HGT Result Item is:
 ** Tagged to the drug in the Insulin Scale configuration.
 ** Mapped to an Observation Panel where nurses record HGT values.
**

Sample data for configuring the Insulin scale:
|Low|High|BMI <25 KG/M2 |BMI 25 - 30 KG/M2|BMI > 30 KG/M2|Bedtime|
|0|150|0|0|0|0|
|151|200|1|2|3|0|
|201|250|2|4|6|1|
|251|300|3|6|9|2|
|301|350|4|8|12|3|
|351|400|5|10|15|3|
|401|600|6|12|18|3|

*EMAR Enhancements:*

Inside the pop-up of each bubble, user should be able to view the following fields along with the existing fields:

1) HGT - Latest value will be pulled from Charting and should be non-editable

2) A mandatory check box will be introduced to identify whether nurse is administering pre meal insulin or bedtime. 
 * Field name: Is this a pre-Meal dose? 
 * Field response: Yes/No
 * Manual input by the user.
 * 
h4. Logic

If pre-Meal= Yes:
 * Use regular correction dose scale. The determination of pre-Meal dose will be done from Protocol Level

If pre-Meal= No:
 * Use bedtime correction dose scale. The determination of bedtime dose will be done from Protocol Level

3) Suggested Correction dose -
 * Non-editable field and auto-populate when pre-Meal(Yes/No) is selected.
 * This will be pulled from the insulin scale if configured configuration available in the insulin scale in drug master.
 * If insulin is bedtime dose, then correction dose will be pulled from bedtime protocol else from other protocol with respect to BMI and HGT value.

4) *Suggested Total Dose (Prescribed Dose + Correction Dose)* -
 * Non-editable field and auto-populate when pre-Meal(Yes/No) is selected.
 * This will be the addition of the Dosage prescribed by the Doctor and Suggested Correction dose from insulin scale.
 * Nurse may accept or ignore the recommendation.
 * Nurse can administer any dosage as clinically required.
 * The name of the field should be - *Suggested Total Dose (Prescribed Dose + Correction Dose)*
 * The Suggested Total Dose can be considered by the Nurse for administration. Nurse would edit the administered dosage with the total suggested dose to proceed. - *QA to confirm this behavior.*

*!image-2026-08-12-17-34-11-018.png|width=509,height=310!*

5) *Hypoglycemia Logic:*

If *HGT<70,* System shall not display any alert 'Initiate Hypoglycemia Protocol'. Do not calculate or show value for correction dosage or suggested total dosage.

*Audit Log:*

Below field has to be added to the Audit log against each bubble. 
 * New fields in audit log: Dosage, Suggested Correction dose, pre-Meal check, Suggested Total Dose will be displayed in the audit log.
 * These new fields will be only available in the UI if the Insulin flag is enabled in drug master and the Non-Critical Insulin protocol type has been selected in CPOE. Else, these new fields should not appear in the audit log of the bubble.

!image-2026-08-12-15-49-07-423.png|width=476,height=172!

jira_task.summary: GRN changes to support HUMVO verification
jira_task.description:
h2. Business Objective

Introduce a configurable Medicines Verification System (MVS) workflow for EMVO Reportable items during the GRN process.

This enhancement will:
 * Allow Data Matrix scanning for medicine packs.
 * Capture GTIN, Serial Number, Batch Number, and other encoded details.
 * Verify each scanned pack through the MVS portal.
 * Retrieve and store Pack Status and Pack Reason.
 * Allow duplicate Item + Batch entries when each pack has a unique serial number.
 * Prevent approval of unverified or invalid packs.
 * Maintain the existing GRN workflow for non-EMVO items and clients who do not enable the feature.

----
h2. Scope
 * New MVS configuration in App Settings.
 * New configuration to allow duplicate items in GRN.
 * Data Matrix scanning during GRN entry.
 * Line-level MVS API invocation.
 * Pack Status and Pack Reason retrieval.
 * Approval validation based on Pack Status.
 * EMVO Reportable item processing.
 * Reference-domain mapping for Pack Status and Pack Reason.

h1. Configuration
h2. Configuration 1

*Path:* App Settings → Inventory → Medicines Verification System

*Type:* Toggle

*Default Value:* Disabled

When enabled, the MVS workflow shall be applicable.

When disabled, the existing GRN workflow shall continue.
h2. Configuration 2

*Path:* App Settings → Inventory → Allow Duplicate Items in GRN

*Type:* Toggle

*Default Value:* Disabled

When enabled:
 * Same Item and Batch can exist in multiple GRN rows.
 * Each row must contain a unique Serial Number.

When disabled:
 * Existing duplicate validation shall continue.

----
h1. GRN Fields

For EMVO Reportable items, the following information shall be maintained:
 * GTIN
 * Serial Number
 * Pack Status
 * Pack Reason
 * Batch Number
 * Other values available in the Data Matrix code

----
h1. Functional Requirements
h2. FR1: Applicability

The workflow shall be applicable only when:
 * Medicines Verification System = Enabled
 * Item Master → EMVO Reportable = Enabled

If either condition is not met, the item shall follow the existing GRN workflow.
h2. FR2: Data Matrix Scanning

During GRN entry:
 * The user shall place the cursor on the Item Name field.
 * The user shall scan the Data Matrix code.
 * The system shall automatically decode and populate available values such as:
 ** GTIN
 ** Serial Number
 ** Batch Number
 ** Expiry Date (if available)
 ** Other supported attributes

----
h2. FR3: Duplicate Item Handling

When "Allow Duplicate Items in GRN" is enabled:
 * The same Item and Batch Number may be received in multiple GRN rows.
 * Each row must have a unique Serial Number.
 * Duplicate Item + Batch combinations shall be permitted only when Serial Numbers are unique.

----
h2. FR4: Line-Level MVS Verification

When scanning for an EMVO Reportable item is completed and the user moves to the next line:
 * The scan will continue in the next line.

----
h2. FR5: MVS Response Handling

The interface response shall return:
 * Pack Status Code
 * Pack Reason Code

The system shall map the returned values to the corresponding GRN line.
----
h2. FR6: Reference Domain Mapping

Pack Status and Pack Reason shall be configured using reference domains.

When the interface returns a code:
 * If a matching reference value exists, the corresponding description shall be populated.
 * If no matching reference value exists:
 ** Pack Status shall remain blank.
 ** Pack Reason shall remain blank.

----
h2. FR7: Auto Approval Restriction

When:
 * Medicines Verification System is enabled
 * The GRN contains EMVO Reportable items

The Auto Approval functionality shall not be executed.

The GRN shall proceed through manual approval only even if the store is configured as GRN Auto approve.
----
h2. FR8: Approval Validation

GRN approval shall be allowed only when:
 * Every EMVO Reportable item has a Pack Status.

----
h2. FR9: Empty Pack Status Validation

If one or more EMVO Reportable items contain a blank Pack Status:
 * Approval shall be blocked.
 * The affected rows shall be highlighted.
 * The following message shall be displayed:

{quote}"Pack status required to approve the GRN."
{quote}
----
h2. FR10: Mixed GRN Handling

A GRN may contain both:
 * EMVO Reportable items
 * Non-EMVO items

For such GRNs:
 * MVS verification shall be performed only for EMVO Reportable items.
 * Non-EMVO items shall follow the current workflow.
 * Approval shall remain blocked until all EMVO Reportable items satisfy approval conditions.

----
h2. FR11: Post Approval Workflow

Once the GRN is approved successfully:
 * Existing inventory workflows shall continue without any changes.

----
h2. FR13: MVS Confirmation API Trigger After GRN Approval
 * Upon successful GRN approval, the system shall trigger an outbound API call with the approved GRN details.
 * The API shall be triggered only for GRNs containing *EMVO Reportable* items.
 * The outbound request shall be initiated after the approval transaction is successfully completed.
 * The API payload shall contain the GRN details required by the external Medicines Verification System process.
 * The exact request and response structure shall be finalized as part of the interface specification.

h2. FR14: Post Approval Processing
 * If the API call is successful, the system shall continue with the existing workflow.
 * The API response shall be stored for audit/troubleshooting if interface logging is enabled.
 * The response should be saved in the DB. Not required to display in front end. 

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*Acceptance Criteria*

AC1

Given Medicines Verification System is disabled
When a GRN is processed
Then the existing workflow shall continue.

AC2

Given Medicines Verification System is enabled
And EMVO Reportable = Enabled for the item
When the item is entered in GRN
Then the MVS workflow shall be applicable.

AC3

Given the user scans a Data Matrix code
When the scan is completed
Then GTIN, Serial Number, Batch Number, and other available values shall be populated automatically.

AC4

Given Allow Duplicate Items in GRN is enabled
When the same Item and Batch are added in multiple lines with different Serial Numbers
Then the system shall allow the GRN entry.

AC5

Given a scan is completed for an EMVO Reportable item
When the user moves to the next line
Then the system shall invoke the MVS API for that line item.

AC6

Given the interface returns Pack Status and Pack Reason codes
When matching reference values exist
Then the corresponding descriptions shall be populated.

AC7

Given the interface returns a code not available in the reference domain
When the response is processed
Then Pack Status and/or Pack Reason shall remain blank.

AC8

Given the GRN contains EMVO Reportable items
When Auto Approval conditions are met
Then Auto Approval shall not execute.

AC9

Given an EMVO Reportable item has a blank Pack Status
When the user attempts GRN approval
Then approval shall be blocked
And the item shall be highlighted
And the message "Pack status required to approve the GRN" shall be displayed.

AC10

Given an EMVO Reportable item has Pack Status other than Active
When the user attempts GRN approval
Then approval shall be blocked.

AC11

Given non-Active items are removed
And all remaining EMVO Reportable items have Pack Status = Active
When approval is attempted again
Then the system shall allow GRN approval.

AC12

Given a GRN contains both EMVO and non-EMVO items
When the GRN is processed
Then only EMVO Reportable items shall participate in MVS verification.

AC13

Given the GRN is approved successfully
When post-approval processing begins
Then the existing inventory workflow shall continue unchanged.

requirement_analysis.functional_requirement:
h2. Business Objective

Introduce a configurable Medicines Verification System (MVS) workflow for EMVO Reportable items during the GRN process.

This enhancement will:
 * Allow Data Matrix scanning for medicine packs.
 * Capture GTIN, Serial Number, Batch Number, and other encoded details.
 * Verify each scanned pack through the MVS portal.
 * Retrieve and store Pack Status and Pack Reason.
 * Allow duplicate Item + Batch entries when each pack has a unique serial number.
 * Prevent approval of unverified or invalid packs.
 * Maintain the existing GRN workflow for non-EMVO items and clients who do not enable the feature.

----
h2. Scope
 * New MVS configuration in App Settings.
 * New configuration to allow duplicate items in GRN.
 * Data Matrix scanning during GRN entry.
 * Line-level MVS API invocation.
 * Pack Status and Pack Reason retrieval.
 * Approval validation based on Pack Status.
 * EMVO Reportable item processing.
 * Reference-domain mapping for Pack Status and Pack Reason.

h1. Configuration
h2. Configuration 1

*Path:* App Settings → Inventory → Medicines Verification System

*Type:* Toggle

*Default Value:* Disabled

When enabled, the MVS workflow shall be applicable.

When disabled, the existing GRN workflow shall continue.
h2. Configuration 2

*Path:* App Settings → Inventory → Allow Duplicate Items in GRN

*Type:* Toggle

*Default Value:* Disabled

When enabled:
 * Same Item and Batch can exist in multiple GRN rows.
 * Each row must contain a unique Serial Number.

When disabled:
 * Existing duplicate validation shall continue.

----
h1. GRN Fields

For EMVO Reportable items, the following information shall be maintained:
 * GTIN
 * Serial Number
 * Pack Status
 * Pack Reason
 * Batch Number
 * Other values available in the Data Matrix code

----
h1. Functional Requirements
h2. FR1: Applicability

The workflow shall be applicable only when:
 * Medicines Verification System = Enabled
 * Item Master → EMVO Reportable = Enabled

If either condition is not met, the item shall follow the existing GRN workflow.
h2. FR2: Data Matrix Scanning

During GRN entry:
 * The user shall place the cursor on the Item Name field.
 * The user shall scan the Data Matrix code.
 * The system shall automatically decode and populate available values such as:
 ** GTIN
 ** Serial Number
 ** Batch Number
 ** Expiry Date (if available)
 ** Other supported attributes

----
h2. FR3: Duplicate Item Handling

When "Allow Duplicate Items in GRN" is enabled:
 * The same Item and Batch Number may be received in multiple GRN rows.
 * Each row must have a unique Serial Number.
 * Duplicate Item + Batch combinations shall be permitted only when Serial Numbers are unique.

----
h2. FR4: Line-Level MVS Verification

When scanning for an EMVO Reportable item is completed and the user moves to the next line:
 * The scan will continue in the next line.

----
h2. FR5: MVS Response Handling

The interface response shall return:
 * Pack Status Code
 * Pack Reason Code

The system shall map the returned values to the corresponding GRN line.
----
h2. FR6: Reference Domain Mapping

Pack Status and Pack Reason shall be configured using reference domains.

When the interface returns a code:
 * If a matching reference value exists, the corresponding description shall be populated.
 * If no matching reference value exists:
 ** Pack Status shall remain blank.
 ** Pack Reason shall remain blank.

----
h2. FR7: Auto Approval Restriction

When:
 * Medicines Verification System is enabled
 * The GRN contains EMVO Reportable items

The Auto Approval functionality shall not be executed.

The GRN shall proceed through manual approval only even if the store is configured as GRN Auto approve.
----
h2. FR8: Approval Validation

GRN approval shall be allowed only when:
 * Every EMVO Reportable item has a Pack Status.

----
h2. FR9: Empty Pack Status Validation

If one or more EMVO Reportable items contain a blank Pack Status:
 * Approval shall be blocked.
 * The affected rows shall be highlighted.
 * The following message shall be displayed:

{quote}"Pack status required to approve the GRN."
{quote}
----
h2. FR10: Mixed GRN Handling

A GRN may contain both:
 * EMVO Reportable items
 * Non-EMVO items

For such GRNs:
 * MVS verification shall be performed only for EMVO Reportable items.
 * Non-EMVO items shall follow the current workflow.
 * Approval shall remain blocked until all EMVO Reportable items satisfy approval conditions.

----
h2. FR11: Post Approval Workflow

Once the GRN is approved successfully:
 * Existing inventory workflows shall continue without any changes.

----
h2. FR13: MVS Confirmation API Trigger After GRN Approval
 * Upon successful GRN approval, the system shall trigger an outbound API call with the approved GRN details.
 * The API shall be triggered only for GRNs containing *EMVO Reportable* items.
 * The outbound request shall be initiated after the approval transaction is successfully completed.
 * The API payload shall contain the GRN details required by the external Medicines Verification System process.
 * The exact request and response structure shall be finalized as part of the interface specification.

h2. FR14: Post Approval Processing
 * If the API call is successful, the system shall continue with the existing workflow.
 * The API response shall be stored for audit/troubleshooting if interface logging is enabled.
 * The response should be saved in the DB. Not required to display in front end. 

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

AC1

Given Medicines Verification System is disabled
When a GRN is processed
Then the existing workflow shall continue.

AC2

Given Medicines Verification System is enabled
And EMVO Reportable = Enabled for the item
When the item is entered in GRN
Then the MVS workflow shall be applicable.

AC3

Given the user scans a Data Matrix code
When the scan is completed
Then GTIN, Serial Number, Batch Number, and other available values shall be populated automatically.

AC4

Given Allow Duplicate Items in GRN is enabled
When the same Item and Batch are added in multiple lines with different Serial Numbers
Then the system shall allow the GRN entry.

AC5

Given a scan is completed for an EMVO Reportable item
When the user moves to the next line
Then the system shall invoke the MVS API for that line item.

AC6

Given the interface returns Pack Status and Pack Reason codes
When matching reference values exist
Then the corresponding descriptions shall be populated.

AC7

Given the interface returns a code not available in the reference domain
When the response is processed
Then Pack Status and/or Pack Reason shall remain blank.

AC8

Given the GRN contains EMVO Reportable items
When Auto Approval conditions are met
Then Auto Approval shall not execute.

AC9

Given an EMVO Reportable item has a blank Pack Status
When the user attempts GRN approval
Then approval shall be blocked
And the item shall be highlighted
And the message "Pack status required to approve the GRN" shall be displayed.

AC10

Given an EMVO Reportable item has Pack Status other than Active
When the user attempts GRN approval
Then approval shall be blocked.

AC11

Given non-Active items are removed
And all remaining EMVO Reportable items have Pack Status = Active
When approval is attempted again
Then the system shall allow GRN approval.

AC12

When the GRN is processed

AC13

When post-approval processing begins
Then the existing inventory workflow shall continue unchanged.

requirement_analysis.functional_requirement:
h2. Business Objective

Introduce a configurable Medicines Verification System (MVS) workflow for EMVO Reportable items during the GRN process.

This enhancement will:
 * Allow Data Matrix scanning for medicine packs.
 * Capture GTIN, Serial Number, Batch Number, and other encoded details.
 * Verify each scanned pack through the MVS portal.
 * Retrieve and store Pack Status and Pack Reason.
 * Allow duplicate Item + Batch entries when each pack has a unique serial number.
 * Prevent approval of unverified or invalid packs.
 * Maintain the existing GRN workflow for non-EMVO items and clients who do not enable the feature.

----
h2. Scope
 * New MVS configuration in App Settings.
 * New configuration to allow duplicate items in GRN.
 * Data Matrix scanning during GRN entry.
 * Line-level MVS API invocation.
 * Pack Status and Pack Reason retrieval.
 * Approval validation based on Pack Status.
 * EMVO Reportable item processing.
 * Reference-domain mapping for Pack Status and Pack Reason.

h1. Configuration
h2. Configuration 1

*Path:* App Settings → Inventory → Medicines Verification System

*Type:* Toggle

*Default Value:* Disabled

When enabled, the MVS workflow shall be applicable.

When disabled, the existing GRN workflow shall continue.
h2. Configuration 2

*Path:* App Settings → Inventory → Allow Duplicate Items in GRN

*Type:* Toggle

*Default Value:* Disabled

When enabled:
 * Same Item and Batch can exist in multiple GRN rows.
 * Each row must contain a unique Serial Number.

When disabled:
 * Existing duplicate validation shall continue.

----
h1. GRN Fields

For EMVO Reportable items, the following information shall be maintained:
 * GTIN
 * Serial Number
 * Pack Status
 * Pack Reason
 * Batch Number
 * Other values available in the Data Matrix code

----
h1. Functional Requirements
h2. FR1: Applicability

The workflow shall be applicable only when:
 * Medicines Verification System = Enabled
 * Item Master → EMVO Reportable = Enabled

If either condition is not met, the item shall follow the existing GRN workflow.
h2. FR2: Data Matrix Scanning

During GRN entry:
 * The user shall place the cursor on the Item Name field.
 * The user shall scan the Data Matrix code.
 * The system shall automatically decode and populate available values such as:
 ** GTIN
 ** Serial Number
 ** Batch Number
 ** Expiry Date (if available)
 ** Other supported attributes

----
h2. FR3: Duplicate Item Handling

When "Allow Duplicate Items in GRN" is enabled:
 * The same Item and Batch Number may be received in multiple GRN rows.
 * Each row must have a unique Serial Number.
 * Duplicate Item + Batch combinations shall be permitted only when Serial Numbers are unique.

----
h2. FR4: Line-Level MVS Verification

When scanning for an EMVO Reportable item is completed and the user moves to the next line:
 * The scan will continue in the next line.

----
h2. FR5: MVS Response Handling

The interface response shall return:
 * Pack Status Code
 * Pack Reason Code

The system shall map the returned values to the corresponding GRN line.
----
h2. FR6: Reference Domain Mapping

Pack Status and Pack Reason shall be configured using reference domains.

When the interface returns a code:
 * If a matching reference value exists, the corresponding description shall be populated.
 * If no matching reference value exists:
 ** Pack Status shall remain blank.
 ** Pack Reason shall remain blank.

----
h2. FR7: Auto Approval Restriction

When:
 * Medicines Verification System is enabled
 * The GRN contains EMVO Reportable items

The Auto Approval functionality shall not be executed.

The GRN shall proceed through manual approval only even if the store is configured as GRN Auto approve.
----
h2. FR8: Approval Validation

GRN approval shall be allowed only when:
 * Every EMVO Reportable item has a Pack Status.

----
h2. FR9: Empty Pack Status Validation

If one or more EMVO Reportable items contain a blank Pack Status:
 * Approval shall be blocked.
 * The affected rows shall be highlighted.
 * The following message shall be displayed:

{quote}"Pack status required to approve the GRN."
{quote}
----
h2. FR10: Mixed GRN Handling

A GRN may contain both:
 * EMVO Reportable items
 * Non-EMVO items

For such GRNs:
 * MVS verification shall be performed only for EMVO Reportable items.
 * Non-EMVO items shall follow the current workflow.
 * Approval shall remain blocked until all EMVO Reportable items satisfy approval conditions.

----
h2. FR11: Post Approval Workflow

Once the GRN is approved successfully:
 * Existing inventory workflows shall continue without any changes.

----
h2. FR13: MVS Confirmation API Trigger After GRN Approval
 * Upon successful GRN approval, the system shall trigger an outbound API call with the approved GRN details.
 * The API shall be triggered only for GRNs containing *EMVO Reportable* items.
 * The outbound request shall be initiated after the approval transaction is successfully completed.
 * The API payload shall contain the GRN details required by the external Medicines Verification System process.
 * The exact request and response structure shall be finalized as part of the interface specification.

h2. FR14: Post Approval Processing
 * If the API call is successful, the system shall continue with the existing workflow.
 * The API response shall be stored for audit/troubleshooting if interface logging is enabled.
 * The response should be saved in the DB. Not required to display in front end.

Given Medicines Verification System is disabled
When a GRN is processed
Then the existing workflow shall continue.

AC2

Given Medicines Verification System is enabled
And EMVO Reportable = Enabled for the item
When the item is entered in GRN
Then the MVS workflow shall be applicable.

AC3

Given the user scans a Data Matrix code
When the scan is completed
Then GTIN, Serial Number, Batch Number, and other available values shall be populated automatically.

AC4

Given Allow Duplicate Items in GRN is enabled
When the same Item and Batch are added in multiple lines with different Serial Numbers
Then the system shall allow the GRN entry.

AC5

Given a scan is completed for an EMVO Reportable item
When the user moves to the next line
Then the system shall invoke the MVS API for that line item.

AC6

Given the interface returns Pack Status and Pack Reason codes
When matching reference values exist
Then the corresponding descriptions shall be populated.

AC7

Given the interface returns a code not available in the reference domain
When the response is processed
Then Pack Status and/or Pack Reason shall remain blank.

AC8

Given the GRN contains EMVO Reportable items
When Auto Approval conditions are met
Then Auto Approval shall not execute.

AC9

Given an EMVO Reportable item has a blank Pack Status
When the user attempts GRN approval
Then approval shall be blocked
And the item shall be highlighted
And the message "Pack status required to approve the GRN" shall be displayed.

AC10

Given an EMVO Reportable item has Pack Status other than Active
When the user attempts GRN approval
Then approval shall be blocked.

AC11

Given non-Active items are removed
And all remaining EMVO Reportable items have Pack Status = Active
When approval is attempted again

requirement_analysis.functional_requirement:
h2. Business Objective

Introduce a configurable Medicines Verification System (MVS) workflow for EMVO Reportable items during the GRN process.

This enhancement will:
 * Allow Data Matrix scanning for medicine packs.
 * Capture GTIN, Serial Number, Batch Number, and other encoded details.
 * Verify each scanned pack through the MVS portal.
 * Retrieve and store Pack Status and Pack Reason.
 * Allow duplicate Item + Batch entries when each pack has a unique serial number.
 * Prevent approval of unverified or invalid packs.
 * Maintain the existing GRN workflow for non-EMVO items and clients who do not enable the feature.

----
h2. Scope
 * New MVS configuration in App Settings.
 * New configuration to allow duplicate items in GRN.
 * Data Matrix scanning during GRN entry.
 * Line-level MVS API invocation.
 * Pack Status and Pack Reason retrieval.
 * Approval validation based on Pack Status.
 * EMVO Reportable item processing.
 * Reference-domain mapping for Pack Status and Pack Reason.

h1. Configuration
h2. Configuration 1

*Path:* App Settings → Inventory → Medicines Verification System

*Type:* Toggle

*Default Value:* Disabled

When enabled, the MVS workflow shall be applicable.

When disabled, the existing GRN workflow shall continue.
h2. Configuration 2

*Path:* App Settings → Inventory → Allow Duplicate Items in GRN

*Type:* Toggle

*Default Value:* Disabled

When enabled:
 * Same Item and Batch can exist in multiple GRN rows.
 * Each row must contain a unique Serial Number.

When disabled:
 * Existing duplicate validation shall continue.

----
h1. GRN Fields

For EMVO Reportable items, the following information shall be maintained:
 * GTIN
 * Serial Number
 * Pack Status
 * Pack Reason
 * Batch Number
 * Other values available in the Data Matrix code

----
h1. Functional Requirements
h2. FR1: Applicability

The workflow shall be applicable only when:
 * Medicines Verification System = Enabled
 * Item Master → EMVO Reportable = Enabled

If either condition is not met, the item shall follow the existing GRN workflow.
h2. FR2: Data Matrix Scanning

During GRN entry:
 * The user shall place the cursor on the Item Name field.
 * The user shall scan the Data Matrix code.
 * The system shall automatically decode and populate available values such as:
 ** GTIN
 ** Serial Number
 ** Batch Number
 ** Expiry Date (if available)
 ** Other supported attributes

----
h2. FR3: Duplicate Item Handling

When "Allow Duplicate Items in GRN" is enabled:
 * The same Item and Batch Number may be received in multiple GRN rows.
 * Each row must have a unique Serial Number.
 * Duplicate Item + Batch combinations shall be permitted only when Serial Numbers are unique.

----
h2. FR4: Line-Level MVS Verification

When scanning for an EMVO Reportable item is completed and the user moves to the next line:
 * The scan will continue in the next line.

----
h2. FR5: MVS Response Handling

The interface response shall return:
 * Pack Status Code
 * Pack Reason Code

The system shall map the returned values to the corresponding GRN line.
----
h2. FR6: Reference Domain Mapping

Pack Status and Pack Reason shall be configured using reference domains.

When the interface returns a code:
 * If a matching reference value exists, the corresponding description shall be populated.
 * If no matching reference value exists:
 ** Pack Status shall remain blank.
 ** Pack Reason shall remain blank.

----
h2. FR7: Auto Approval Restriction

When:
 * Medicines Verification System is enabled
 * The GRN contains EMVO Reportable items

The Auto Approval functionality shall not be executed.

The GRN shall proceed through manual approval only even if the store is configured as GRN Auto approve.
----
h2. FR8: Approval Validation

GRN approval shall be allowed only when:
 * Every EMVO Reportable item has a Pack Status.

----
h2. FR9: Empty Pack Status Validation

If one or more EMVO Reportable items contain a blank Pack Status:
 * Approval shall be blocked.
 * The affected rows shall be highlighted.
 * The following message shall be displayed:

{quote}"Pack status required to approve the GRN."
{quote}
----
h2. FR10: Mixed GRN Handling

A GRN may contain both:
 * EMVO Reportable items
 * Non-EMVO items

For such GRNs:
 * MVS verification shall be performed only for EMVO Reportable items.
 * Non-EMVO items shall follow the current workflow.
 * Approval shall remain blocked until all EMVO Reportable items satisfy approval conditions.

----
h2. FR11: Post Approval Workflow

Once the GRN is approved successfully:
 * Existing inventory workflows shall continue without any changes.

----
h2. FR13: MVS Confirmation API Trigger After GRN Approval
 * Upon successful GRN approval, the system shall trigger an outbound API call with the approved GRN details.
 * The API shall be triggered only for GRNs containing *EMVO Reportable* items.
 * The outbound request shall be initiated after the approval transaction is successfully completed.
 * The API payload shall contain the GRN details required by the external Medicines Verification System process.
 * The exact request and response structure shall be finalized as part of the interface specification.

h2. FR14: Post Approval Processing
 * If the API call is successful, the system shall continue with the existing workflow.
 * The API response shall be stored for audit/troubleshooting if interface logging is enabled.
 * The response should be saved in the DB. Not required to display in front end.

Given Medicines Verification System is disabled
When a GRN is processed
Then the existing workflow shall continue.

AC2

Given Medicines Verification System is enabled
And EMVO Reportable = Enabled for the item
When the item is entered in GRN
Then the MVS workflow shall be applicable.

AC3

Given the user scans a Data Matrix code
When the scan is completed
Then GTIN, Serial Number, Batch Number, and other available values shall be populated automatically.

AC4

Given Allow Duplicate Items in GRN is enabled
When the same Item and Batch are added in multiple lines with different Serial Numbers
Then the system shall allow the GRN entry.

AC5

Given a scan is completed for an EMVO Reportable item
When the user moves to the next line
Then the system shall invoke the MVS API for that line item.

AC6

Given the interface returns Pack Status and Pack Reason codes
When matching reference values exist
Then the corresponding descriptions shall be populated.

AC7

Given the interface returns a code not available in the reference domain
When the response is processed
Then Pack Status and/or Pack Reason shall remain blank.

AC8

Given the GRN contains EMVO Reportable items
When Auto Approval conditions are met
Then Auto Approval shall not execute.

AC9

Given an EMVO Reportable item has a blank Pack Status
When the user attempts GRN approval
Then approval shall be blocked
And the item shall be highlighted
And the message "Pack status required to approve the GRN" shall be displayed.

AC10

Given an EMVO Reportable item has Pack Status other than Active
When the user attempts GRN approval
Then approval shall be blocked.

AC11

When approval is attempted again

requirement_analysis.functional_requirement:
h2. Business Objective

Introduce a configurable Medicines Verification System (MVS) workflow for EMVO Reportable items during the GRN process.

This enhancement will:
 * Allow Data Matrix scanning for medicine packs.
 * Capture GTIN, Serial Number, Batch Number, and other encoded details.
 * Verify each scanned pack through the MVS portal.
 * Retrieve and store Pack Status and Pack Reason.
 * Allow duplicate Item + Batch entries when each pack has a unique serial number.
 * Prevent approval of unverified or invalid packs.
 * Maintain the existing GRN workflow for non-EMVO items and clients who do not enable the feature.

----
h2. Scope
 * New MVS configuration in App Settings.
 * New configuration to allow duplicate items in GRN.
 * Data Matrix scanning during GRN entry.
 * Line-level MVS API invocation.
 * Pack Status and Pack Reason retrieval.
 * Approval validation based on Pack Status.
 * EMVO Reportable item processing.
 * Reference-domain mapping for Pack Status and Pack Reason.

h1. Configuration
h2. Configuration 1

*Path:* App Settings → Inventory → Medicines Verification System

*Type:* Toggle

*Default Value:* Disabled

When enabled, the MVS workflow shall be applicable.

When disabled, the existing GRN workflow shall continue.
h2. Configuration 2

*Path:* App Settings → Inventory → Allow Duplicate Items in GRN

*Type:* Toggle

*Default Value:* Disabled

When enabled:
 * Same Item and Batch can exist in multiple GRN rows.
 * Each row must contain a unique Serial Number.

When disabled:
 * Existing duplicate validation shall continue.

----
h1. GRN Fields

For EMVO Reportable items, the following information shall be maintained:
 * GTIN
 * Serial Number
 * Pack Status
 * Pack Reason
 * Batch Number
 * Other values available in the Data Matrix code

----
h1. Functional Requirements
h2. FR1: Applicability

The workflow shall be applicable only when:
 * Medicines Verification System = Enabled
 * Item Master → EMVO Reportable = Enabled

If either condition is not met, the item shall follow the existing GRN workflow.
h2. FR2: Data Matrix Scanning

During GRN entry:
 * The user shall place the cursor on the Item Name field.
 * The user shall scan the Data Matrix code.
 * The system shall automatically decode and populate available values such as:
 ** GTIN
 ** Serial Number
 ** Batch Number
 ** Expiry Date (if available)
 ** Other supported attributes

----
h2. FR3: Duplicate Item Handling

When "Allow Duplicate Items in GRN" is enabled:
 * The same Item and Batch Number may be received in multiple GRN rows.
 * Each row must have a unique Serial Number.
 * Duplicate Item + Batch combinations shall be permitted only when Serial Numbers are unique.

----
h2. FR4: Line-Level MVS Verification

When scanning for an EMVO Reportable item is completed and the user moves to the next line:
 * The scan will continue in the next line.

----
h2. FR5: MVS Response Handling

The interface response shall return:
 * Pack Status Code
 * Pack Reason Code

The system shall map the returned values to the corresponding GRN line.
----
h2. FR6: Reference Domain Mapping

Pack Status and Pack Reason shall be configured using reference domains.

When the interface returns a code:
 * If a matching reference value exists, the corresponding description shall be populated.
 * If no matching reference value exists:
 ** Pack Status shall remain blank.
 ** Pack Reason shall remain blank.

----
h2. FR7: Auto Approval Restriction

When:
 * Medicines Verification System is enabled
 * The GRN contains EMVO Reportable items

The Auto Approval functionality shall not be executed.

The GRN shall proceed through manual approval only even if the store is configured as GRN Auto approve.
----
h2. FR8: Approval Validation

GRN approval shall be allowed only when:
 * Every EMVO Reportable item has a Pack Status.

----
h2. FR9: Empty Pack Status Validation

If one or more EMVO Reportable items contain a blank Pack Status:
 * Approval shall be blocked.
 * The affected rows shall be highlighted.
 * The following message shall be displayed:

{quote}"Pack status required to approve the GRN."
{quote}
----
h2. FR10: Mixed GRN Handling

A GRN may contain both:
 * EMVO Reportable items
 * Non-EMVO items

For such GRNs:
 * MVS verification shall be performed only for EMVO Reportable items.
 * Non-EMVO items shall follow the current workflow.
 * Approval shall remain blocked until all EMVO Reportable items satisfy approval conditions.

----
h2. FR11: Post Approval Workflow

Once the GRN is approved successfully:
 * Existing inventory workflows shall continue without any changes.

----
h2. FR13: MVS Confirmation API Trigger After GRN Approval
 * Upon successful GRN approval, the system shall trigger an outbound API call with the approved GRN details.
 * The API shall be triggered only for GRNs containing *EMVO Reportable* items.
 * The outbound request shall be initiated after the approval transaction is successfully completed.
 * The API payload shall contain the GRN details required by the external Medicines Verification System process.
 * The exact request and response structure shall be finalized as part of the interface specification.

h2. FR14: Post Approval Processing
 * If the API call is successful, the system shall continue with the existing workflow.
 * The API response shall be stored for audit/troubleshooting if interface logging is enabled.
 * The response should be saved in the DB. Not required to display in front end. 

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*Acceptance Criteria*

AC1

Given Medicines Verification System is disabled
When a GRN is processed
Then the existing workflow shall continue.

AC2

Given Medicines Verification System is enabled
And EMVO Reportable = Enabled for the item
When the item is entered in GRN
Then the MVS workflow shall be applicable.

AC3

Given the user scans a Data Matrix code
When the scan is completed
Then GTIN, Serial Number, Batch Number, and other available values shall be populated automatically.

AC4

Given Allow Duplicate Items in GRN is enabled
When the same Item and Batch are added in multiple lines with different Serial Numbers
Then the system shall allow the GRN entry.

AC5

Given a scan is completed for an EMVO Reportable item
When the user moves to the next line
Then the system shall invoke the MVS API for that line item.

AC6

Given the interface returns Pack Status and Pack Reason codes
When matching reference values exist
Then the corresponding descriptions shall be populated.

AC7

Given the interface returns a code not available in the reference domain
When the response is processed
Then Pack Status and/or Pack Reason shall remain blank.

AC8

Given the GRN contains EMVO Reportable items
When Auto Approval conditions are met
Then Auto Approval shall not execute.

AC9

Given an EMVO Reportable item has a blank Pack Status
When the user attempts GRN approval
Then approval shall be blocked
And the item shall be highlighted
And the message "Pack status required to approve the GRN" shall be displayed.

AC10

Given an EMVO Reportable item has Pack Status other than Active
When the user attempts GRN approval
Then approval shall be blocked.

AC11

Given non-Active items are removed
And all remaining EMVO Reportable items have Pack Status = Active
When approval is attempted again
Then the system shall allow GRN approval.

AC12

Given a GRN contains both EMVO and non-EMVO items
When the GRN is processed
Then only EMVO Reportable items shall participate in MVS verification.

AC13

Given the GRN is approved successfully
When post-approval processing begins
Then the existing inventory workflow shall continue unchanged.
